author: blu
body: The first thing that is not a test to write the fact store: a real file, read off the wire, signed, and stored as a content-addressed SourceDefinition on the attached disk. It is the ingest half of "delete GitHub" -- the writer the compiler's reader (FactDisk) has been waiting for, so that a source in the repository was put there by a tool a person runs, not only by a test that hardcodes its own work.

author: blu
body: The signing identity is a fixed tool key here. A deployment signs with the box's own identity; that this key is well-known does not weaken the demonstration -- the signature is real and the gate checks it against whatever manifest the reader trusts.
